jobs.about.tick: The server's wake-up every 30 min: it runs Weather, Place sorting and the nightly cleanup's catch-up.
jobs.about.wx: Fetches Tokyo's weather for the island's sky.
jobs.about.places: Sorts saved places into categories with AI; nothing to do without new places.
jobs.about.nightly: Checks the ledgers, sweeps expired share links and prunes old records; anything left retries after 4:15.
jobs.about.backup: Encrypts the record and saves it to the private archive repo.
jobs.about.health: Checks that the server, the record and the site are up, and opens an alert if not.
jobs.about.its-health: Checks that the ITS bot is up; every 15 min while a booking is on.
jobs.about.places-pull: Reads the Google Maps list of saved places.
jobs.about.places-details: Refreshes saved places' opening hours and details (up to 80 a run).
jobs.about.e2e-flake-hunt: Runs the tests many times over to find flaky ones. Its failures go to the flake issue, not to Needs you.
jobs.about.kalori-scrape: Fetches the chain restaurants' menus weekly and updates the app's food data. Too many changes are held for a PR review. A watch checks every 6 hours that it hasn't stalled.
jobs.about.pages: Checks and publishes the app on each push.
jobs.about.e2e-logic-full: Runs every test after a site deploy.
jobs.about.dispatch: The ITS bot starts GitHub's jobs at :15 and :45: Server check, ITS bot check and Google Maps sync. Without it, they pause.
jobs.about.gym: Checks the gym's open slots; more in the Gym tab.
jobs.say.warn: Keep an eye on {names}: late or failed once.
jobs.say.cf: Watch Cloudflare use: {names}; the app stops at 100%.
jobs.cf.stale: Couldn't refresh ({code}); the last reading today.
jobs.cf.old: Last reading from {day} (UTC); the limits have reset since.
jobs.cf.label: {name}, {pct} used, {of}
jobs.about.relay: Checks the relay (the app's server) and deploys it when its code changes.
jobs.fold.label: {name}: {summary}
jobs.cf.about.doRead: Rows the server's database reads today. The app stops at 100%, until the reset at 9:00. Shared by every Worker on the account.
jobs.cf.about.doWrite: Rows the server's database writes today: saves and logs. The app stops at 100%, until the reset at 9:00. Shared by every Worker on the account.
jobs.cf.about.doReq: Calls into the server's database today. The app stops at 100%, until the reset at 9:00. Shared by every Worker on the account.
jobs.cf.about.wReq: Requests to the server today, from the app and the bots. The app stops at 100%, until the reset at 9:00. Shared by every Worker on the account.
jobs.say.cfBad: Cut Cloudflare use: {names}; the app stops at 100%.
